ready1_open_rewrite.title: SciVerse open question
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: In a 400 mL beaker, add 5.00g $\mathrm{PbCl_2}$ and 300 mL water, and heat for 10min. At the end of heating, some solid $\mathrm{PbCl_2}$ still remains undissolved at the bottom of the beaker; cool the solution to room temperature. The next day, take 100 mL of saturated solution into a 250 mL beaker, being careful not to transfer any solid residue. Add 100 mL of 0.75 M KI solution, and the following precipitation reaction occurs: $\mathrm{Pb^{2+} + 2I^- \rightarrow PbI_2(s)}$. Filter, dry, and weigh the $\mathrm{PbI_2}$ precipitate; the mass is 0.747g. What is the amount of substance (mol) of $\mathrm{Pb^{2+}}$ in the $\mathrm{PbI_2}$ precipitate?
